name: Secrets of the Colossus - Ashi
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: I'm looking for battle hardened adventurers willing and able to get a fresh husk sample from the fallen Colossus of Ashi to Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. No, no, I wouldn't want you to go anywhere near that thing's corpse. Just take one of my samples and make it snappy. These things are no good to him rotten!
narrative.objectives: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh the chickens I will craft from this wondrous husk! Well done, my boy !
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes? What have you got there?
